entities.name: Marija Aušrinė Pavilionienė
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Marija Aušrinė Pavilionienė is a Lithuanian philologist, professor, human rights activist, feminist writer and politician. She was a member of Seimas from 2009 to 2016 as a member of the Social Democratic Party, having previously represented the Liberal Democratic Party as a member from 2004 to 2008.
